summary: Flathead County, MT tower on the Flathead National Forest: a 10-foot L-4 tower built in 1937, abandoned 1953, now gone. Sources say nothing about the site today.

notes_for_editor: Only one descriptive page (firelookout.com) gives dates and design; the Forest Lookouts page has no site text beyond agency and township. Height not converted: the 10' may be the tower height but the source does not say so. No staffing, fire, elevation or NHLR/FFLOS record found. Access key omitted. Brief coordinates were not checked against the 19-miles-from-Essex description. A Facebook group post in search results mentions an L-4 at another Flathead site; it was not opened and is not used.
